body:
Hi @dnndev thanks for creating an issue 👍 

Aurelia is a complete framework and it could be quite tricky to integrate instantsearch.js in it. However you could probably use the lower level library that is used internally by instantsearch.js. This library is called the JS Helper and you can find its [documentation here](https://community.algolia.com/algoliasearch-helper-js/) and a few [examples with several frameworks here](https://community.algolia.com/algoliasearch-helper-js/examples.html#use-with-frameworks)
